newsitem.title: CHINA: China's Hongtashan '96 pre-tax profits $975 mln.
newsitem.headline: China's Hongtashan '96 pre-tax profits $975 mln.

text.p: Makers of China's famous Hongtashan cigarettes made pre-tax profits of 8.09 billion yuan ($975 million) in 1996, a company official said on Tuesday.

The Yuxi Cigarette Plant in southwestern Yunnan province earned $115 million in foreign exchange last year through exports, the official said by telephone. He declined to give comparative figures or further details.
Hongtashan, or Red Pagoda Mountain, was China's top cigarette brand last year in terms of both output and sales.
Last month, Hongtashan was named one of China's top brands.
